originalTitle: Airbnb bans making guests do dishes and take out the trash
content: Checking out of your next Airbnb might be less of a hassle now that the company is banning hosts from including time-consuming chores in their house rules. Airbnb’s updated house rules policy, which starts with reservations booked on or after November 20th, says hosts can’t ask guests to “complete tasks that require significant effort or time, or would typically be performed by a cleaner.” According to Airbnb, that includes: * Dishes: Guests shouldn’t be asked to wash and put away dishes, but you can ask them to put used dishes in the sink. * Laundry: Guests shouldn’t be asked to remove sheets from the bed or start a load of laundry, but you can ask them to gather used towels. * Trash: Guests shouldn’t be asked to take garbage off-site, but you can ask them to separate their trash and recycling into designated indoor bins. * Utilities: Guests shouldn’t be asked to avoid using a listed amenity like air conditioning, but you can ask them to turn it off when they leave. Airbnb is displaying hosts’ requests more prominently now in a new “rules and requests” section on listings. You might see an “includes cleaning requests” warning if a host leaves chore requests in their listing after the new policy goes into effect. Hosts aren’t allowed to sneak in extra rules in messages to guests or on signs around their property, either. Some hosts pushed back on the house rules restrictions on Airbnb’s forums, saying they pose health risks and arguing that guests can simply choose not to stay at listings with overly-strict rules. Airbnb says there can be exceptions to the limits on checkout chores, like asking guests to “dispose of trash in an animal-proof container in bear country.”
chineseTitle: Airbnb 禁止客人洗碗和倒垃圾
chineseContent: 既然爱彼迎公司禁止房东将耗时的家务纳入其《房屋守则》中，那么您下次入住 Airbnb 时可能会不再那么麻烦。 Airbnb 更新后的《入住须知》政策从 11 月 20 日或之后的预订开始，规定房东不能要求房客“完成需要大量精力或时间的任务，或者通常由清洁工执行的任务”。根据 Airbnb 的说法，其中包括： * 餐具：不应要求房客清洗并收起餐具，但您可以要求他们将用过的餐具放入水槽中。 * 洗衣：不应要求房客取下床上的床单或开始洗大量衣服，但您可以要求他们收集用过的毛巾。 * 垃圾：不应要求房客将垃圾带出酒店外，但您可以要求他们将垃圾和回收物分类放入指定的室内垃圾箱。 * 公用设施：不应要求房客避免使用空调等列出的设施，但您可以要求他们在离开时将其关闭。 Airbnb 现在在房源的新“规则和请求”部分中更加突出地显示房东的请求。新政策生效后，如果房东在房源中留下家务请求，您可能会看到“包含清洁请求”警告。房东也不得在给房客的消息中或在其房源周围的标志上偷偷加入额外的规则。一些房东在爱彼迎论坛上反驳了房屋规定限制，称这些规定会带来健康风险，并认为房客可以选择不入住规定过于严格的房源。 Airbnb 表示，对于结帐杂务的限制可能会有例外，比如要求客人“在熊的国家将垃圾扔到动物防护容器中”。
